R=C=20; g=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
ones=[(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)]

# Row rays extend away from an off-rectangle marker; unmarked rows extend both ways.
for r in range(2,9):
 ms=[c for rr,c in ones if rr==r and not (9<=c<=15)]
 left=not ms or all(c>15 for c in ms)
 right=not ms or all(c<9 for c in ms)
 if left:
  for c in range(9):g[r][c]=2
 if right:
  for c in range(16,20):g[r][c]=2
# Above/below rays on each rectangle column, unless an aligned marker lies that way.
for c in range(9,16):
 if not any(cc==c and rr<2 for rr,cc in ones):
  for r in range(2):g[r][c]=2
 if not any(cc==c and rr>8 for rr,cc in ones):
  for r in range(9,20):g[r][c]=2
# Original markers remain visible.
for r,c in ones:g[r][c]=1
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
